not_found.name: Unknown
description: Unable to find the requested ki power.

abundant_step.name: Abundant Step
description: ::ab{title="&L&Abundant Step (Su)&FN&" icon=magic move="A monk with this ki power can slip magically between spaces, as if using the spell ‹spell/dimension door›. Using this ability consumes 2 ki points. The monk's caster level for this effect is equal to his monk level. He cannot take other creatures with him when he uses this ability." prereq="8th-level monk"}

action_before_thought.name: Action Before Thought
description: ::ab{title="&L&Action Before Thought (Ex)&FN&" icon=roll free="A monk with this ability can spend 2 ki points as part of rolling initiative to roll twice on the initiative check and take the higher result." prereq="6th-level monk"}

breaking_down_koan.name: Breaking-Down Koan
description: ::ab{title="&L&Breaking-Down Koan (Su)&FN&" icon=lower swift="A monk with this ability can spend 1 ki point to present a paradox, riddle, or complicated question to a creature within 30 feet. The creature must succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the monk's level + his Wisdom modifier) or be ‹misc/confused› for 1 round." special="This is a mind-affecting, language-dependent effect." prereq="8th-level monk"}

building_up_koan.name: Building-Up Koan
description: ::ab{title="&L&Building-Up Koan (Su)&FN&" icon=def-boost-down swift="A monk with this ability can spend 2 ki points to ask himself a koan, which he then tries to answer. The monk must attempt a Will save (DC 15 + 1/2 the monk's level). If successful, he gains an insight bonus equal to his Wisdom modifier to AC and on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks and until the end of the round. If he fails, the monk is instead ‹misc/confused› for 1 round." special="This is a mind-affecting, language-dependent effect. A character who can't become confused can't benefit from this ability." prereq="8th-level monk"}

master_thought_koan.name: Master-Thought Koan
description: ::ab{title="&L&Master-Thought Koan (Su)&FN&" icon=boost ability="A monk with this ability can spend an additional 2 ki points when using either the *breaking-down koan* or *building-up koan* ki powers. When combined with *master-thought koan, breaking-down koan* affects a number of characters of your choice within 30 feet equal to the monk's wisdom modifier. When combined with *master-thought koan, building-up koan* can be used on an ally within 30 feet." prereq="12th-level monk, either ‹kipower/breaking-down koan› or ‹kipower/building-up koan›"}

diamond_body.name: Diamond Body
description: ::ab{title="&L&Diamond Body (Su)&FN&" icon=def ability="By spending 1 ki point, a monk with this power can remove one toxin from his body as if using ‹spell/neutralize poison›, using his monk level as his caster level. He can remove only one poison in this way per use of this ability." prereq="8th-level monk"}

cobra_breath.name: Cobra Breath
description: ::ab{title="&L&Cobra Breath (Su)&FN&" icon=zap ability="Whenever a monk with this ki power uses *diamond body* to neutralize a poison, he can instead release that poison as a ranged touch attack against a single foe within 30 feet. If the attack hits, the foe must succeed at a saving throw (using the poison's original DC) or suffer the poison's effects, even if it was not originally a contact poison." prereq="12th-level monk, ‹kipower/diamond body›"}

diamond_mind.name: Diamond Mind
description: ::ab{title="&L&Diamond Mind (Su)&FN&" icon=def swift="By spending 1 ki point, a monk with this power can suppress a fear effect affecting him as if using ‹spell/remove fear›, using his monk level as his caster level." special="He can spend 2 ki points to activate this ability even when ‹misc/frightened› or ‹misc/panicked›." prereq="6th-level monk"}

diamond_resilience.name: Diamond Resilience
description: ::ab{title="&L&Diamond Resilience (Ex)&FN&" icon=def swift="By spending 1 ki point, the monk gains DR 2/-." imp16="The damage reduction increases to 4/-." imp19="It increases to DR 6/-." special="This DR lasts for 1 minute." prereq="12th-level monk"}

diamond_soul.name: Diamond Soul
description: ::ab{title="&L&Diamond Soul (Ex)&FN&" icon=def swift="A monk can spend 2 ki points to gain spell resistance equal to his monk level + 10. This spell resistance lasts for a number of rounds equal to the monk's level." prereq="12th-level monk"}

ki_volley.name: Ki Volley
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Volley (Su)&FN&" icon=def-magic immediate="When a targeted spell or spell-like ability fails to overcome the monk's spell resistance from *diamond soul,* he can spend 2 ki points to send that spell back at its caster as ‹spell/spell turning›." prereq="16th-level monk, ‹kipower/diamond soul›"}

elemental_fury.name: Elemental Fury
description: ::ab{title="&L&Elemental Fury (Su)&FN&" order=cw icon=melee-boost choice="A monk who selects this ki power must select one type of energy: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. Once this choice is made, it cannot be changed." swift="The monk can expend 1 ki point to imbue his natural attacks with the chosen energy, causing them to deal 1d6 points of damage of the chosen type for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 his monk level." prereq="6th-level monk"}

elemental_burst.name: Elemental Burst
description: ::ab{title="&L&Elemental Burst (Su)&FN&" icon=cone ability="A monk with this ability can spend 4 ki points to unleash a gout of energy in a 30-foot cone. Creatures within the cone take 20d6 points of damage of the same type as the monk's *elemental fury* ki power. A Reflex save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the monk's level + his Wisdom modifier) halves the damage." prereq="18th-level monk, ‹kipower/elemental fury›"}

empty_body.name: Empty Body
description: ::ab{title="&L&Empty Body (Su)&FN&" icon=magic move="A monk with this ki power gains the ability to assume an ethereal state for 1 minute as though using the spell ‹spell/etherealness›, using his monk level as his caster level. Using this ability consumes 3 points from the monk's ki pool." special="This ability affects only the monk and cannot be used to make other creatures ethereal."}

feather_balance.name: Feather Balance
description: ::ab{title="&L&Feather Balance (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost swift="A monk with this ability can spend 1 ki point to achieve perfect balance. While this is active, the monk treats any ‹skill/Acrobatics› attempt made to balance as if he had rolled a 20. This ability lasts for 1 minute."}

light_steps.name: Light Steps
description: ::ab{title="&L&Light Steps (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost flavor="A monk with this ki power can move effortlessly across nearly any surface." ability="Whenever the monk activates his *feather balance* ki power, he can also ignore all ‹rule/difficult terrain›. In addition, while active, he can cross any solid surface, even if it would normally not support his weight. This does not allow him to walk on liquids." prereq="8th-level monk, ‹kipower/feather balance›"}

floating_breath.name: Floating Breath
description: ::ab{title="&L&Floating Breath (Su)&FN&" icon=magic swift="A monk with this ki power can spend 1 ki point to balance on the air, hovering in place, until the end of his next turn. This power does not allow the monk to fly or otherwise move into the air; he must jump or use some other ability to reach his position. This otherwise functions as ‹spell/air walk›." prereq="8th-level monk"}

formless_mastery.name: Formless Mastery
description: ::ab{title="&L&Formless Mastery (Ex)&FN&" icon=def-boost flavor="A monk with this ability varies his styles, never repeating the same move twice and capitalizing on the weaknesses of an opponent's style." immediate="As long as he does not possess any style feat, the monk can spend 1 ki point to gain the following against opponents in the stance of a style feat: a +4 dodge bonus to AC, a +4 circumstance bonus on attack rolls, and a bonus equal to his monk level on damage rolls. These bonuses last until the end of the monk's next turn (or his current turn if he uses this ability on his own turn)." special="The monk can activate this ability and the ‹kipower/furious defense› ki power with the same immediate action for a total cost of 3 ki points." prereq="7th-level monk"}

freedom_of_movement.name: Freedom of Movement
description: ::ab{title="&L&Freedom of Movement (Su)&FN&" icon=magic swift="A monk with this ability can spend 1 ki point to gain the effects of ‹spell/freedom of movement› for 1 round." prereq="8th-level monk"}

furious_defense.name: Furious Defense
description: ::ab{title="&L&Furious Defense (Ex)&FN&" icon=def immediate="By spending 1 ki point, a monk with this ki power can grant himself a +4 dodge bonus to AC until the end of his next turn." special="The monk can activate this ability and the ‹kipower/formless mastery› ki power with the same immediate action for a total cost of 3 ki points." prereq="7th-level monk"}

high_jump.name: High Jump
description: ::ab{title="&L&High Jump (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost order=pw passive="A monk with this ki power adds his level as a bonus on all ‹skill/Acrobatics› checks to jump, both for vertical jumps and horizontal jumps. In addition, he always counts as having a running start when attempting Acrobatics checks to jump." swift="By spending 1 ki point, the monk gains a +20 bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump for 1 round."}

wind_jump.name: Wind Jump
description: ::ab{title="&L&Wind Jump (Su)&FN&" icon=power move="A monk with this ki power can spend 1 ki point to grant himself a fly speed (with perfect maneuverability) equal to his base land speed. He must end his movement each round on solid ground (or some other surface that can support his weight) or fall as normal. Once activated, this ability lasts for 1 minute." prereq="8th-level monk, ‹kipower/high jump›"}

improvised_weapon_proficiency.name: Improvised Weapon Proficiency
description: ::ab{title="&L&Improvised Weapon Proficiency (Ex, Su)&FN&" icon=boost passive="A monk with this ability does not take a penalty on attack rolls for using an ‹misc/improvised weapon›." ability="By spending 1 ki point, the monk can fight with a ‹misc/broken› weapon without taking any penalties on attack rolls or damage rolls for 1 round." order=pa}

insightful_wisdom.name: Insightful Wisdom
description: ::ab{title="&L&Insightful Wisdom (Su)&FN&" icon=protect immediate="A monk with this ability can spend 2 ki points to give another ally within 30 feet just the right word of advice to prevent disaster. If the ally can hear the monk, she can reroll a single attack roll or saving throw. The ally must take the second result, even if it is worse." prereq="8th-level monk"}

ki_blocker.name: Ki Blocker
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Blocker (Su)&FN&" icon=lower free="A monk with this ability can spend 1 ki point before making an unarmed strike against a foe. If the attack hits, the monk can interrupt the target's flow of ki.~~~If the monk successfully damages the target of his attack, that opponent's cost to activate abilities with ki increases by 1 ki point for 1 hour." special="If the monk spends 2 ki points, he can use this ability to affect the target's *arcane pool, arcane reservoir, grit points, inspiration,* or *panache points* instead of its ki pool. The effects of this ability do not stack, but multiple hits increase the duration by 1 hour for each hit." prereq="10th-level monk"}

ki_guardian.name: Ki Guardian
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Guardian (Su)&FN&" icon=protect immediate="Before he rolls a saving throw against a targeted effect that also targets other allies or an area effect whose area includes other allies, a monk with this ability can spend any number of ki points and designate a number of adjacent allies equal to the number of ki points spent.~~~The monk rolls one saving throw for each designated ally, using his bonus instead of the ally's. For each successful saving throw, the corresponding ally treats the effect as if that ally had succeeded at the saving throw, and for each saving throw failed, the corresponding ally treats the effect as if that ally had failed the saving throw.~~~If the monk fails any of the saving throws (including his own original saving throw), the monk treats the effect as if he had failed the saving throw." prereq="6th-level monk"}

ki_meditation.name: Ki Meditation
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Meditation (Su)&FN&" icon=boost fullround="A monk with this ability can spend 2 ki points to meditate, as if using Combat Meditation. Alternatively, he can spend 4 ki points to meditate as a @HLmove_action instead." special="Using these ki points does not count as one of the monk's daily uses of Combat Meditation, but it grants him the usual benefits he would gain from his meditation feats for doing so." prereq="‹feat/Combat Meditation›"}

ki_metabolism.name: Ki Metabolism
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Metabolism (Su)&FN&" order=pm icon=def-power flavor="A monk with this ability uses his ki to control his metabolism." passive="As long as he has at least 1 point remaining in his ki pool, the monk needs to eat and drink only 1/4 as often as normal, needs only 2 hours of sleep each night (including to replenish his ki pool), and can ‹misc/hold his breath› for up to 1 hour per point of Constitution." move="He can spend 1 ki point to enter a state of suspended animation, falling unconscious and appearing dead to all senses. At the time he enters this state, he indicates a preset period of time or a triggering condition, after which he awakens."}

ki_mount.name: Ki Mount
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Mount (Su)&FN&" icon=aid standard="A monk with this ability can spend 1 ki point to grant 2 ‹rule/temporary hit points› per monk level he possesses to his mount for 1 hour per monk level. As long as the monk and his mount are adjacent or the monk is mounted, the mount shares the benefits of whichever of the *AC bonus, evasion, high jump, improved evasion, ki strike, perfect self,* and *still mind* abilities the monk possesses." prereq="6th-level monk"}

ki_range.name: Ki Range
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Range (Su)&FN&" icon=ranged-boost swift="A monk with this ability can spend 1 ki point to increase the range increment of any thrown monk weapon by 20 feet." special="Apply this benefit before doubling the range increment with the ‹feat/Far Shot› feat."}

ki_sunder.name: Ki Sunder
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Sunder (Ex)&FN&" icon=boost free="A monk with this ability can spend 1 ki point when attempting a ‹rule/sunder› combat maneuver check to add his monk level as a bonus to the damage roll."}

bare_hand_block.name: Bare-Hand Block
description: ::ab{title="&L&Bare-Hand Block (Ex)&FN&" icon=melee immediate="A monk with this ability can spend 1 ki point when attacked with a manufactured weapon to attempt an unarmed ‹rule/sunder› combat maneuver check against it. If he successfully sunders the weapon and grants it the ‹misc/broken› condition, the attack deals no damage." special="He can spend an additional 1 ki point when using this ability to activate *ki sunder* as a @HLfree_action." prereq="8th-level monk, ‹kipower/ki sunder›"}

ki_visions.name: Ki Visions
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Visions (Su)&FN&" icon=power flavor="A monk with this ability often sees visions of spirits or hears the voice of his departed mentor in his dreams." ability="On any given night during which the monk dreams, he can use this ability to gain the benefits of a ‹spell/divination›. If he does, he spends 2 ki points from the next day's total." prereq="10th-level monk"}

one_touch.name: One Touch
description: ::ab{title="&L&One Touch (Ex)&FN&" icon=touch standard="As long as he has at least 1 point remaining in his ki pool, a monk with this power can make an unarmed strike against a foe as a touch attack. He adds 1/2 his monk level as a bonus on the damage roll." special="He can spend 1 ki point to double this bonus for that attack." prereq="12th-level monk"}

qinggong_power.name: Qinggong Power
description: ::ab{title="&L&Qinggong Power (Su)&FN&" icon=power ability="A monk with this power selects any of the ‹arc-monk/qinggong monk› ki powers for which he qualifies based on his monk level." special="A monk can select this ability multiple times. Each time, he must select a different qinggong monk ki power."}

quivering_palm.name: Quivering Palm
description: ::ab{title="&L&Quivering Palm (Su)&FN&" icon=lower standard="A monk can set up vibrations within the body of another creature that can thereafter be fatal if the monk so desires. Using this ability costs 4 ki points, and the monk must announce his intent to use this ability (and spend the ki points) before making the attack roll.~~~Creatures immune to critical hits cannot be affected. Otherwise, if the attack hits and the target takes damage from the blow, the *quivering palm* attack succeeds. Thereafter, the monk can try to slay the victim at any time within a number of days equal to his monk level. To make such an attempt, the monk merely wills the target to die (a @HLfree_action); unless the target succeeds at a Fortitude saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 the monk's level + the monk's Wisdom modifier), it dies.~~~If the saving throw is successful, the target is no longer in danger from that particular *quivering palm* attack, but it can still be affected by another one at a later time." special="A monk can have no more than one *quivering palm* in effect at one time. If a monk uses *quivering palm* while another is still in effect, the previous one is negated." prereq="16th-level monk"}

racing_current.name: Racing Current
description: ::ab{title="&L&Racing Current (Su)&FN&" icon=magic move="A monk with this ki power can create a wave to help him maneuver allies upon the battlefield, as if using the spell ‹spell/slipstream›. Using this ability costs 2 ki points, and the ability remains in effect for 1 minute." prereq="6th-level monk"}

slow_fall.name: Slow Fall
description: ::ab{title="&L&Slow Fall (Su)&FN&" icon=def ability="A monk within arm's reach of a wall can use it to slow his descent by expending 1 ki point. When he uses this ability, he takes no damage from the fall (as if using ‹spell/feather fall›), but he must be adjacent to a wall for the length of the fall (although this can be used to reduce the damage from a fall if only part of it is adjacent to a wall)."}

sudden_speed.name: Sudden Speed
description: ::ab{title="&L&Sudden Speed (Su)&FN&" icon=boost swift="A monk with this ki power can spend 1 ki point to grant himself a sudden burst of speed. This increases the monk's base land speed by 30 feet for 1 minute."}

branch_runner.name: Branch Runner
description: ::ab{title="&L&Branch Runner (Ex, Su)&FN&" icon=boost passive="A monk with this ability adds half the base speed bonus from his *fast movement* ability to his racial climb speed. In addition, when he uses the *sudden speed* ki power, he adds the base speed bonus from that ki power to his racial climb speed for 1 round." prereq="‹kipower/Sudden speed›"}

ki_hurricane.name: Ki Hurricane
description: ::ab{title="&L&Ki Hurricane (Ex)&FN&" icon=power-melee fullround="A monk with this ability can move up to twice his speed. At any point in that movement, the monk can spend 1 ki point to make the first attack in his *flurry of blows.* He can later spend another ki point to make the next attack in his *flurry of blows,* and so on, until he either stops spending ki points or has exhausted all the attacks from his *flurry of blows.*" prereq="10th-level monk, ‹kipower/sudden speed›"}

water_sprint.name: Water Sprint
description: ::ab{title="&L&Water Sprint (Su)&FN&" icon=magic swift="A monk with this ki power can spend 1 ki point to gain the ability to walk on water, as if under the effects of ‹spell/water walk›. Once activated, this ability lasts for 1 minute per monk level." prereq="6th-level monk"}

wholeness_of_body.name: Wholeness of Body
description: ::ab{title="&L&Wholeness of Body (Su)&FN&" icon=aid flavor="A monk with this ki power can heal his own wounds." ability="By spending 2 ki points, he can heal an amount of damage equal to 1d8 + his monk level."}

zephyr_blow.name: Zephyr Blow
description: ::ab{title="&L&Zephyr Blow (Su)&FN&" icon=magic standard="By spending 1 ki point, a monk with this power can disrupt the wind and create a sharp blast of air, as if using the spell ‹spell/gust of wind›. The monk's caster level for this effect is equal to his monk level."}
